Problem Statement & Proposed Solution

Project Motivation

⚠️ Challenges of Legacy Grading

  • Manual Arithmetic Errors: Recalculating hundreds of scores manually leads to grade discrepancy.
  • Data Inconsistency: Spreadsheets risk accidental row deletion and lack foreign key validation.
  • Publication Latency: Transcripts take weeks to format, verify, and print physically.
  • Zero Security Controls: Plain files have no session auth or CSRF defense.

✨ The SRMS Digital Solution

  • Automated Engine: Instant total, percentage, grade, and pass/fail calculations.
  • Live Client-Side Preview: Visual progress bar and score tracker while entering marks.
  • Interactive Analytics: Real-time Chart.js visual charts on admin dashboard.
  • Instant Verified Search: Students can view and print authenticated marksheets immediately.

System Architecture & Tech Stack

3-Tier Architecture

🎨 Frontend Tier

Bootstrap 5.3 + Glassmorphism CSS

  • Responsive flexbox layout
  • Bootstrap Icons (1.11)
  • Chart.js interactive data canvas
  • Google Fonts (Poppins / Plus Jakarta)

⚙️ Logic & Server Tier

PHP 8 Runtime Engine

  • Session-based admin authentication
  • CSRF token verification system
  • Prepared statement execution
  • Dynamic grade calculation engine

🗄️ Persistence Tier

MySQL 8 Relational Database

  • ACID compliant transaction engine
  • Foreign key constraints (CASCADE)
  • UTF8mb4 character encoding
  • Indexed enrollment search queries

Key Modules & Functional Highlights

System Features

👥 Student Registry Module

Full lifecycle management allowing faculty to add, modify, search, and delete student records with unique university enrollment validation.

⚡ Live Marks Evaluation Engine

Real-time calculation widget calculating aggregate total marks (500), percentage, grade tier (A+ to F), and pass/fail evaluation as values are typed.

📊 Executive Analytics Dashboard

Comprehensive overview displaying total students, average class percentage, pass rates, and visual subject performance bar charts.

📜 Digital Marksheet Portal

Fast public search portal allowing instant lookup by roll number, generating a print-ready official university grade sheet.

Relational Database Design

Database Schema

`admins` Table

  • id (PK, AUTO_INCREMENT)
  • username (VARCHAR 50, UNIQUE)
  • password (VARCHAR 255, Hashed)
  • created_at (TIMESTAMP)

`students` Table

  • id (PK, AUTO_INCREMENT)
  • enrollment_no (VARCHAR 20, UNIQUE)
  • student_name, email
  • course, semester, section

`results` Table

  • id (PK), student_id (FK)
  • 5 Subject Marks (0–100)
  • total_marks, percentage
  • grade, result_status

Security, Conclusion & Future Scope

Summary

🔒 Robust Security Protocols

  • CSRF Token Protection: Cryptographic session tokens on all mutating POST forms.
  • SQL Injection Prevention: Strict prepared statements with parameter binding.
  • XSS Sanitization: Universal htmlspecialchars() output encoding.
  • BCRYPT Password Hashing: Secure key derivation for admin accounts.

🚀 Future Roadmap & Conclusion

  • Multi-Role System: Dedicated logins for Students & Evaluators.
  • Automated Alerts: Instant SMS & Email result notifications.
  • QR Code Verification: Digital verification of printed transcripts.
  • Conclusion: Successfully delivers a modern, reliable, and secure result management system.
